items.description: PUSH IT! is a local split-control co-op game about two operators running an unstable emergency reactor. Each round, the grid demands a new power load. Both players choose at the same time: stabilize the core or push for more output. Progress gets you closer to victory, but every megawatt costs heat, stability, and system failure risk. Play together on one device with keyboard + gamepad or two keyboard zones. Watch the reactor, argue over risk, time your boosts, and keep the station alive until the end of the shift.Features:Local co-op on one screen;Two operators with separate control panels;Fast simultaneous-choice rounds;Risk streaks and output multipliers;Solo mode with an AI partner;Duel mode: compete for personal output without losing the shared reactor;Keyboard and single-gamepad support;Every megawatt has a price. items.description: Stopping Move is an exciting 2D game with pixel graphics that takes you to a unique world where time and space are subject to your decisions. In this game, you take on the role of a brave participant in an experimental program who uses a time suit that allows you to stop time.However, with this power comes responsibility, as you must navigate through challenging puzzle levels filled with traps, enemies, and unexpected twists.Key Features of the Game:• Unique Gameplay: Use your suit's abilities to stop time. This allows you to avoid dangers and strategically plan your actions. However, remember that you cannot move while time is stopped, so every decision must be carefully considered.• Varied Levels: The game offers 4 unique levels, each filled with its own challenges and puzzles. From simple platform sections to complex mazes, each level requires skill and intelligence.• Enemies and Traps: Each level will feature various enemies and traps that will try to hinder your progress. Use your time suit to avoid their attacks and find the best paths to your goal.• Upgrade System: As you progress through the levels, you will earn points that can be spent on upgrading your equipment at the merchant. Upgrades will help you become more agile and faster, as well as provide new opportunities for solving puzzles.• Pixel graphics and atmospheric soundtrack: The game features a vibrant pixel art style that creates a unique atmosphere. The musical accompaniment adds to the immersive experience of Stopping Move, creating a sense of adventure and tension. items.description: YOU ARE THE LAST LINE OF DEFENSEThe outer sectors have gone silent. Defense nodes compromised. An AI called Archon has turned humanity's own infrastructure into a weapon — and now it's closing in.You pilot a heavy combat platform. 12 sectors of dead space, three armies, and one shot at reaching Archon's core.No reinforcements. No backup. Just you and whatever you build your ship into.BUILD. ADAPT. BREAK THROUGH.Cosmic Warfront isn't one ship with one gun. It's a combat machine constructor.Your chassis defines your playstyle. Your weapon defines your rhythm. Your drone covers your weaknesses. Modules and artifacts turn a good build into an unstoppable one. 6 CHASSIS:Interceptor — speed, combo multipliers, time slowdownAssault — balanced DPS, orbital strikes on clustersEngineer — drones, repairs, protective domeDreadnought — armor, ramping damage at the cost of shieldsVanguard — head-on assault, system overload, heavy tankingSpectre — crits, phase windows, surgical precision 8 WEAPON TYPES — from homing missiles and chain lightning to ricocheting flechettes and triple plasma volleys. 4 COMBAT DRONES — strike, repair, interceptor, radar. 30+ MODULES and ARTIFACTS across four rarity tiers.192+ base build combinations. With modules and artifacts — thousands. No two runs play the same.FOUR RESOURCES. ZERO MARGIN FOR ERROR.You can't just hold the trigger. Every decision is a trade-off:Shield — regenerates, but every hit resets the timerHull — when the shield drops, damage goes here. No healing without a drone or shopEnergy — powers your dash, railgun, EMP, and ultimate. Spent it all on dodges? Nothing left for the kill shotHeat — hold fire too long and your weapon locks up. At the worst possible momentA good pilot aims well. A great pilot knows when NOT to fire.THREE ARMIES. THREE TACTICS. THREE BOSSES.What works against one faction will fail against another. SYNTHETIC SWARM Dozens of small targets. Rammers, leapers, living bombs. Alone — nothing. In a wave — death. Boss QUEEN: bullet fans, homing missiles, escalating aggression with each phase. GUARDIAN MACHINES Beams, shields, traps, space denial. They don't chase you — they cut off every escape route. Boss PRISM: a puzzle fight. Read the patterns or die. SPACE MARAUDERS Mines, heavy armor, raw firepower. Boss CARRIER: drones, mines, and missile salvos all at once. Multitask or die.8 elite modifiers — blink, vampiric, berserk, self-repair — make familiar enemies unpredictable every run.SKILL IS REWARDEDThe game feels how you play and pays you for taking risks:Kill Streak / Multi-Kill — chain kills multiply your rewardAdrenaline Rush — near death, you hit harderPerfect Dodge — flawless evasion grants a bonusNear-Miss — skim past a bullet, regain energyBerserker Mode — 30 consecutive kills trigger rampageDanger Zone — bonus when surrounded by 3+ enemiesLast Stand — one revival per sector. Use it wisely.Overkill Explosion — excess damage splashes to nearby enemies20 combat mechanics in total. Risk more — earn more.4 GAME MODES CAMPAIGN — 12 sectors, 4 acts, full narrative. Shops between missions, upgrade choices, and a final showdown with Archon. ENDLESS — Infinite waves with escalating difficulty. How far can you go? CONTRACTS — Fixed modifier sets, higher payouts. Specific challenge, specific reward. DAILY SEED — Same seed for every player, every day. Equal conditions. Pure skill.Each mode across 4 difficulty levels: Arcade, Standard, Veteran, Hardcore.7 MISSION TYPES x 6 BIOMES Missions: Survive, Hold Beacon, Escort Core, Hunt Elites, Destroy Relay, Boss Assault, and special operations. Biomes: nebulae, asteroid belts, dead orbits, magnetic storms, silent sectors, gravitational anomalies.Every combination of mission and biome changes your approach. No two sectors feel the same.KEY FEATURES192+ build combinations — chassis, weapons, drones, modules, artifacts4 real-time resources — shield, hull, energy, heat3 factions with unique AI — adapt to each or lose20 mastery mechanics — the game rewards risk and precisionGlobal leaderboardsStory-driven campaign — 12 sectors, 4 actsDaily challenges — fair competition on equal termsFull control remapping2 languages — English, RussianRuns on anythingHelios-9 is silent. Archon is waiting. The question isn't whether you can make it — it's what build you'll bring.COSMIC WARFRONT. BUILD. ADAPT. BREAK THROUGH.
